facts.fact: The DIAL case study says Uganda continued its digital policy 'through 2023, when it launched its Digital Transformation Roadmap' (verb: launched; no adopting act or body named).

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance

systems.tiers: Aims to make Uganda one of the top digital governments in Africa by 2027
Created after NITA-U's 2012 E-government Readiness Assessment, with Korean support

note: Data-exchange case study. The Roadmap's scope is not described here, so class is empty; the Digital Government Strategy (target 2027) and E-Government Masterplan are state-administration strategies, so systems only.
